desc:
⚽ KICK BALL FOR SOCCER PLAYERS ⚽
Kick the ball as far as you can, land it in a stadium and pull a footballer for your team!

🏆 NEW: WORLD CUP UPDATE 🏆
• A World Cup match every 20 minutes – pick your nation and score for it!
• Aim your shot yourself: hit the goal to win a national player and Trophies
• Miss and the player gets away – aim for the corners!
• TOP 100 scorers of every match win a SUPER SHOT + bonus Trophies
• Score with a Super Shot to unlock the exclusive 5th player of the final
• World Cup Index with 50 national players and the World Cup Legend
• World Cup Shop with daily and weekly offers
• New leaderboard: World Cup goals

🏟️ ALSO NEW
• 2 new stadiums: Icons 90s and Icons 2000s with 16 new players
• 2 new Club Legends
• 8 new goal upgrades
• 4 new balls

💪 HOW TO PLAY
• Train your power and kick further to reach better stadiums
• Collect footballers – rarer players earn more cash
• Fill your Index to unlock Club Legends
